name: Financial Question-answering Dataset for Slovak
description: A multiple-choice question-answering dataset specifically designed for evaluating Slovak language models in the financial domain. It contains 1,334 questions with one correct and four incorrect answers, organized by topic and difficulty to facilitate structured evaluation of domain-specific capabilities.
reputation: A niche, newly introduced Slovak finance QA dataset with limited public adoption so far.
notes: Focuses on Slovak financial domain; enables comparison of domain-specific vs general question answering.
